data.name: Heat Aura
data.description: As a swift action, you can cause waves of heat to radiate from your body. This heat deals %1d4 points of fire damage to all creatures within 10 feet. A Reflex save halves this damage. In addition, your form wavers and blurs, granting you 20%% concealment until your next turn. You can use this ability %2 times per day|max(1,classlevel("Oracle")/2)|1+(classlevel("Oracle")/5)
